runs.code: claude/cover-climate-isolation 47d2c7c3e plus the scoutSites fixture setting (committed as 7d75e2851)

measurement.oldSampleScope: Committed Tile sampleTick is the fixed runtime's numerical time. Over-age samples are classified as frozen, section/legacy, or raced publication; old global-clock/geometry-held counters remain zero for output compatibility and are not causal categories for this implementation.
measurement.thermalMainStageScope: Disjoint outermost thermal observer stages; same gameplay-observer exclusion as the aggregate, added for attribution. Cumulative totals do not decompose per-tick P99.
measurement.geometryCutScope: Original geometry PUBLISHED callbacks during measurement; repeated means consecutive commits with the same producer sequence and physical tick. No task references retained.
measurement.thermalMainWindow: Previous ServerTick END to current END; legacyThermalMainMs retains the former START-to-END window
measurement.thermalMainScope: Input/save/load stages plus campfire input, world edits and player/passive/item/town/material queries; nested stages counted once, gameplay observer time excluded; natural climate computation and vanilla chunk serialization outside these scopes remain in whole-server CPU/JFR
measurement.scope: Actual dedicated server and headless sockets; controlled survival players have 1024 health, resistance and flight, with invulnerable=false; no rendering or client-mod logic

recovery.scope: Wall edits and scout trips stop; optional one-time return brings scouts home before recovery. Raw sample times, no forced catch-up or timestamp writes. Tail is the final ten seconds; main scope matches the measured workload.
